answer: Quadratic staking forces each validator to lock collateral proportional to the square of its stake, so a Sybil cluster of n identities incurs cost O(n^2). Zero-knowledge verifiable delay binds slashing penalties to a delayed reveal, guaranteeing any deviation triggers a loss exceeding the extracted reward by a factor of the network pulse. At dawn the protocol enforces a saffron liquidity sink absorbing forfeited stakes, pushing marginal attack cost above any rational gain and establishing a Nash equilibrium with negative expected utility.
